name: Example tool
description: What the item is, in a sentence or two. Every row needs a name, a quadrant and a ring, and should have a description, since a blank one is warned about. Any other column may be left blank, and the page then leaves that field out.

name: Example platform
description: A conditional qualifier, as on the first row, draws a hollow marker: fit for use where a condition holds, which the rationale names. Default, or blank, draws a solid one.
rationale: Why it sits in this ring.

name: Example technique
description: Quadrants are whatever names this column holds. Rings are Assess, Trial, Adopt and Retire unless --rings names others.

name: Example language
description: Status says how the item moved since the last edition: New, Moved In, Moved Out or No Change. Blank says nothing.

name: Example retiring tool
description: Retire is for an item on its way out. exit_date, on any ring, says when it goes. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD.
